name: tracine
description: Tracine's Claude Code plugin catalog. Safety, observability, and evaluation tooling for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Safety hooks for Claude Code (rm -rf, credential exfil, force-pushes, protected files, subagent scope) with a queryable JSONL decision log.

plugins.name: convo
plugins.description: SQLite-backed analytics CLI for Claude Code sessions. Indexes session logs, full-text search across transcripts, tool-call analytics, atomic snapshot/restore.
